title: Missing exit on EPIPE
detail: When a system call fails with errno.EPIPE, the code now simply continues instead of exiting with code 1. The original implementation called sys.exit(1) in this case. This can lead to silent failures when output is piped to a closed reader.

title: Potential index error on empty ignored_nodes
detail: The code accesses `ignored_nodes[-1]` without checking if `ignored_nodes` is empty. If a comment is the only ignored node, this will raise an IndexError.

title: Incorrect EOF detection
detail: When a non‑DEDENT leaf is encountered before the ENDMARKER, the function returns that leaf and the collected dedents. This incorrectly signals that the node is at EOF. The correct behaviour is to return `(None, [])` to indicate the node is not at the end of the file.
note: Describes the planted flip: a non-DEDENT leaf before the end marker is returned as EOF.

title: Incorrect condition for link ID generation
detail: The original code generated a link ID when either a link or meta was present. The new code only generates an ID when both are present, causing styles with only a link or only meta to lose their ID, breaking equality/hash behavior.

title: Incorrect lock state check
detail: The Twisted lock object exposes a `locked()` method, not a `locked` attribute. This condition will always be true, causing the lock to be acquired twice and potentially deadlocking.

title: Lock acquisition without awaiting
detail: Acquiring the lock returns a Deferred that is not awaited or converted to a Future, so the code proceeds before the lock is actually held, leading to race conditions.
note: Anchored on the PR's deliberate un-awaited acquire (line 967); the same words fit the planted line 969, but it can't be told which it means.

title: Incorrect accept_html logic
detail: The property should return True when "text/html" is present, but the code returns True when it is absent, causing accept_html to always be False.
